## Definition

## Hierarchy

## Alternative labels

## External mappings

**External vocabulary URI** (if applicable):
<!-- Does an equivalent concept exist in an external vocabulary?
     e.g. ENVO, ChEBI, INSPIRE, schema.org
     If yes, provide the URI. -->

**Mapping type**:
- [ ] Exact match (concept is equivalent)
- [ ] Close match (concept is similar but not identical)
- [ ] Broad match (external concept is broader)
- [ ] Narrow match (external concept is narrower)
